# CANDIDATE: SNIPER_PARAMS_KEEPER0_TOP

**Filed:** 2026-07-21  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We are testing a sniper strategy parameter set aiming to improve edge by increasing volume requirements (vol_mult=1.1), tightening body minimum (body_min_cents=0.02), requiring higher quality (min_stars=2), and adjusting exit parameters (profit lock at 5% with 5% offset). The hypothesis is that these changes will filter out low-quality entries and improve risk-adjusted returns. However, the negative edge_capture suggests the changes may have overfit to noise or removed valid signals.

## Mechanism

Entry triggers require: volume ≥ 1.1 × 20-bar average volume, candle body ≥ 2 cents, minimum 2 stars (based on confluence/scoring), and strike offset of 2 (OTM puts). Exits include: 10% premium stop, 50% TP1 at 50% quantity, runner target of 200% profit, profit lock arms at 5% profit with trailing stop 5% below high-water mark, and proximity to level of $1.5. Entries also require breaking above the open (likely to avoid false breakdowns).
